desc:
CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: Real peanuts; Real peanut power; Positively bursting with savory peanuts and sweet granola; A must-have for an on-the-go snack or in a lunch box

SWEET AND SALTY: Nature Valley Sweet and Salty Nut Bars provides a perfect balance of savory nuts and sweet granola

PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Easy bars for snack time or an on-the-go invigorating treat; Perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail

GREAT SNACK: No artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

CONTAINS: One 14.4 oz box of Nature Valley Whole Grain Dark Chocolate Peanut Almond Sweet and Salty Nut Granola Bars; 12 bars
features:
Features

Made with Whole Grain Oats

Each serving contains 21 grams of whole grain, helping to support a healthy, fiber-rich diet.

Rich Dark Chocolate Flavor

Real dark chocolate chunks add a decadent twist to the wholesome oat crunch.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors

Made with simple, recognizable ingredients and no high-fructose corn syrup.

Twin-Pack Convenience

Each pouch contains two crunchy bars—great for portion control and easy sharing.

Non-GMO Ingredients

Crafted with ingredients that are not genetically modified.

Portable and Travel-Friendly

Ideal for hiking, school snacks, office drawers, or emergency snack stashes.

 Benefits

Energy on the Go

Whole grains and a touch of chocolate provide lasting energy without a crash.

Smart Snack Choice

Free of artificial additives and made with oats, it’s a cleaner alternative to candy or cookies.

Delicious Crunch

Satisfying texture makes it a great option for those who enjoy crunchy snacks.

Family Favorite

Loved by kids and adults alike for its balanced flavor and filling nature.

Supports Whole Grain Intake

A tasty way to meet the recommended daily whole grain goals.
ingredients: Roasted Peanuts, Corn Syrup, Sugar, Whole Grain Oats, Dark Chocolate Chunks (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Rice Flour, Palm Kernel Oil, Almonds, Fructose, Cocoa, Vegetable Glycerin, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Soy Lecithin, Corn Starch, Barley Malt Extract, Milk, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Retain Freshness.
